rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for physically blocking someone or holding up an action or process.

example.english: You hamper my efforts to get into the house by standing in the doorway.
example.traditional: 你企喺門口，阻住我入屋喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 kei5 hai2 mun4 hau2 zo2 zyu6 ngo5 jap6 uk1 wo3

rows.note: Use this more formal or written verb when stressing an obstacle to progress or development.

example.traditional: 繁複嘅官僚程序阻礙經濟發展。
example.jyutping: faan4 fuk1 ge3 gun1 liu4 cing4 zeoi6 zo2 ngoi6 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2
